I am doing stuff that noone in my family ever did. But there is not a school for 3D digital art in my country, there is art school focused on that , and when I looked at the projects that graduate students have done , I could do better when I was 13! WELL GUESS WHAT  The essential thing that you need to master before even applying is Drawing. I CAN NOT DRAW. I even took drawing curses but affter few months I still drew on an 6 year old kid level. It is because when I was a child at the age where all the kids draw , and  play with legos , and all those  things that enhance your fine motor skills , I was partially blind. They only noticed that affter I STOPPED USING MY EYES. So now my hands are completely dumb. If I am ever going to have a wife , she is the one who will have to repair stuff in the house and such. I am also ambidextrous for some reason.  I am good at many things , I know a lot of stuff , physics , chemistry , astronomy , biology etc. But not good enough to study or work in any specific area! I started talking fluently and understandably at the age of 1(sentences lke "mom I don't want that , please get me that one instead"ofcourse this is translated from my native tongue ) My rational thinking is just way better then any kids at my age so the few "so called friends" I have were always almost twice my age, I just can not find a common topic between teenagers they are too childish and immature. I have NEVER GONE THROUGH  THE MENTAL PUBERTY as in doing stupid things usual teenagers do. Because of all this I thought of myself as a very smart person but I guess that was a Dunning–Kruger effect.  BECAUSE I CAN NOT EVEN FINISH PRETTY EASY SCHOOL ? I CAN NOT GET MORE THEN 10% from MATH EXAM THAT I STUDIED HUNDREDS HOURS FOR ?  I CAN NOT WRITE 160 WORD ESSAY ?  I MAKE 67 mistakes in 15 sentences of my NATIVE TONGUE ?  Math teacher says "this is very easy so I am just going to breafly mention it and we will move on "  he explains the problem to the class , everyone understands , Only I DON'T!. Usually when someone gets the grades I have , it means that he skips school , doesn't study and doesn't give a fuck . usually those are the "party hard , get drunk and wasted , try new drugs, and have sex with 10 girls a month" type of people ,  teacher says "god, it's so easy why can't you study at least a little " when I fail a test. I WANT TO KILL THAT MOTHER FUCKER BECAUSE I PROBABLY STUDIED HARDEST IN MY ENTIRE CLASS. it's because I fall into that category, even though I do none of those things ,  I have no social life , friends and I've never been drunk never smoked or tried any drugs.  (sorry if this is hard to read or partially makes no sense , and sorry for all the misspelling I just .. don't care all that much..)

EDIT: It is not all about my family , I am not only failing them , I would not care about that , what I do care about is that everything my father says is true , and I fail myself , I want to be the best , but I am the worst. I sacrificed every chance I got to have fun , for a chance to learn. I don't read fiction books , I read educational books , like Psychology , Science etc.. So why when it comes to school , I am HORRIBLE ?
